title: Goodfella's: Henry Hill gets "pinched" as a juvenile. What's with the court room scene and knowing smile between the judge and Hill's representation?

commenti.body: The judge is probably on the take. Anything more than that is reading too far into it. They didn’t set up the pinch but once he was arrested and he handled it the right way, Paulie and Jimmy knew he was solid and therefore could advance him in the organization.

I think it conveys that the judicial system is rigged. The judge is crooked and takes payoffs from the mob in exchange for handing down soft sentences whenever their guys get into legal trouble. The judge recognized the lawyer as one of the mob lawyers who represents their guys and the smile and nod was an acknowledgment of their arrangement.

The judge was most likely paid off and the moustache twirling smile from the legal rep is supposed to symbolise this. Harks to the ending where Henry says "Didn't matter. It didn't mean anything. When I was broke, I'd go out and rob some more. We ran everything. We paid off cops. We paid off lawyers. We paid off judges. Everybody had their hands out. Everything was for the taking. And now it's all over."

It's been a while since i've watched that, but i think it was clear that the judge was paid off and the smile was a "you know what to do" nod. But yeah, now that you mention it, there is no way all those mob bosses would come out to court for someone like Henry. But then we are seeing his memories, and he is probably exagerating them to show how "glamourous" mob life was...

I know the common interpretation is that the judge was simply bribed but my theory always was that Henry was exagerating. What mob boss would spend money on a judge for some part time fencer. The Cops simply caught a, what, 12-14yo kid selling a few cigs

This is obv a pretty large leap but I think Henry tells the story the way he likes it: The gangster prodigy being bailed out by his new found Family who then all show up to congratulate him. 

Even Jimmy shows up and gives him money-a guy who isnt even a part of the family henry runs with and only seems to business with them, knowing henry only from him being a waiter at a mob bar
